name: Self execution

subjectOf.text: Breach of a smart contract is arguably not even possible, because the contract simply will not execute if a parameter is not fulfilled.
subjectOf.abstract: Arguably, breach of a smart contract is not even possible, the contract simply will not execute if a parameter is not fulfilled.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Craig Calcaterra, Crypto Transaction Dispute Resolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2992962
scope_conditions: fully self executing smart contracts on Ethereum

subjectOf.text: Voting arrangements are not self executing: their existence does not relieve the corporation of observing the legal formalities of director and shareholder action.
subjectOf.abstract: Voting arrangements are not self-executing, and the mere existence of a voting arrangement does not mean that the corporation should dispense with the legal formalities of director and shareholder actions.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612
scope_conditions: voting trusts, pooling agreements, and irrevocable proxies

description: 2 claims in the published works of Wulf A. Kaal carry the concept tag 'self-execution'. Derived node: a roster, not an adjudicated definition.
